newsitem.title: USA: US chain store sales fell 0.4 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: US chain store sales fell 0.4 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales decreased 0.4 percent in the week ended September 21 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 3.6 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index dropped 0.7 percent from the prior month.
"Department store sales underperformed discounters but discounters also noted a softer pace of demand during last week," a BTM/Schroders report said.
